title: check

```python
check(df, scale=None, time='year', ref=None)
```

Problems that would stop ``df`` from being a valid panel at ``scale`` (empty list = OK).

Checks: a ``geo_id`` column, ids known at the scale, one row per unit (and
year) and integer years.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type         | Description                                      | Default    |
|--------|--------------|--------------------------------------------------|------------|
| df     | pd.DataFrame | Your panel, e.g. from ``geo.link``               | _required_ |
| scale  | str \| None  | Its scale (default: inferred from ``geo_id``)    | `None`     |
| time   | str \| None  | The year column, or ``None`` for a cross-section | `'year'`   |

## Example {.doc-section .doc-section-example}

```python
!pip install -q geo4bolivia
import geo4bolivia as geo
import plotly.express as px
import pandas as pd

df = pd.DataFrame({"geo_id": ["BO-04-17-04", "BO-04-17-04", "BO-99"],
                   "year": [2024, 2024, 2024], "x": [1, 2, 3]})
geo.check(df, scale="municipality")        # unknown id, duplicate rows
```
